import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXE = MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int[][] dir = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};

    static class Edge {
        int to, w, next;
        Edge(int to, int w, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.w = w;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edge = new Edge[MAXE];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int cnt;

    static int n, T, src = MAXN - 1, sink = src - 1;
    static int[][] sci = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] cap = new int[15][15];
    static int[][][] maze = new int[65][15][15];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[15][15];
    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[65][15][15][15][15];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edge[cnt] = new Edge(v, w, head[u]);
        head[u] = cnt++;
        edge[cnt] = new Edge(u, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = cnt++;
    }

    static int[] parent = new int[MAXN];

    static boolean ekBfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        parent[s] = -2;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edge[i].next) {
                int v = edge[i].to;
                int w = edge[i].w;
                if (parent[v] == -1 && w > 0) {
                    parent[v] = i;
                    q.add(v);
                    if (v == t) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int edmondsKarp(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (ekBfs(s, t)) {
            int f = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = edge[parent[v] ^ 1].to) {
                int i = parent[v];
                f = Math.min(f, edge[i].w);
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = edge[parent[v] ^ 1].to) {
                int i = parent[v];
                edge[i].w -= f;
                edge[i ^ 1].w += f;
            }
            flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int getId(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y + k * n * n;
    }

    static void explore(int sx, int sy, int cx, int cy, int step) {
        vis[cx][cy] = true;
        dp[step][sx][sy][cx][cy] = true;
        if (step >= T || maze[step][cx][cy] != 0) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = cx + dir[d][0];
            int ny = cy + dir[d][1];
            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
            if (vis[nx][ny] || maze[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            explore(sx, sy, nx, ny, step + 1);
        }
    }

    static void init() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        cnt = 0;
        for (int time = 1; time <= T; ++time) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    if (maze[time - 1][x][y] != 0)
                        maze[time][x][y] = maze[time - 1][x][y];
                    else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int xx = x + dir[d][0];
                            int yy = y + dir[d][1];
                            if (xx < 1 || yy < 1 || xx > n || yy > n) continue;
                            if (maze[time - 1][xx][yy] == 2)
                                maze[time][x][y] = 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int a = 1; a <= n; ++a)
                        Arrays.fill(vis[a], false);
                    explore(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= T; ++i)
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; ++xx)
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy)
                            dp[i][x][y][xx][yy] |= dp[i - 1][x][y][xx][yy];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c))
                    sci[i][j] = c - '0';
                else if (c == 'Y')
                    maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z')
                    maze[0][i][j] = 2;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c))
                    cap[i][j] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        init();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0)
                    addEdge(src, getId(i, j, 0), sci[i][j]);
                if (cap[i][j] != 0)
                    addEdge(getId(i, j, 1), sink, cap[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; ++xx)
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy)
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && cap[xx][yy] != 0 && dp[T][x][y][xx][yy])
                            addEdge(getId(x, y, 0), getId(xx, yy, 1), INF);
        System.out.println(edmondsKarp(src, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
